components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per card: create link, copy link, unlock secret. 48px, full card width.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Encrypt & create link <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; width:100%; height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:none; border-radius:10px; background:rgb(var(--c-accent)); color:rgb(var(--c-on-accent)); font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:rgb(var(--c-subtle)); color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral actions: New secret, Cancel, state-card exits.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg> New secret</button>

components.name: Burn Now (Danger Quiet)
components.description: First step of destruction: unfilled red text button that opens the inline confirmation.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-danger-quiet"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 22c4 0 7-3 7-7 0-4-3-6-4-9-1 2-2 3-4 3 0-2-1-4-2-6-2 3-5 6-5 12 0 4 4 7 8 7z"/></svg> Burn now</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-danger-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:none; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:rgb(var(--c-danger)); font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-danger-quiet:hover { background:rgb(var(--c-danger-soft)); } .ds-btn-danger-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line input (passphrase). Blue border plus soft ring on focus; red border when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); border-radius:10px; background:rgb(var(--c-surface)); color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); caret-color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); font-family:"Azeret Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:15px; transition:border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; border-color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.2); } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:rgb(var(--c-danger)); }

components.name: Route Card
components.description: The single lifted surface per route; sections inside are split by hairlines.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width:720px; background:rgb(var(--c-surface)); border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 22 35 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(16 22 35 / 0.12); overflow:hidden; font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); font-size:15px; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-card { box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 12px 32px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-card-body { padding:20px 24px; } .ds-card-rule { border-top:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); }

components.name: Expiry Options
components.description: Six small radio boxes, one row on desktop, 3 by 2 on phones; selected takes the blue wash.
components.html: Expires after
components.css: .ds-expiry { border:0; margin:0; padding:0; font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-expiry legend { font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-expiry-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:6px; } .ds-expiry-opt { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:0 4px; border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); border-radius:9px; background:rgb(var(--c-surface)); color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); font-size:14px; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-expiry-opt:hover { background:rgb(var(--c-subtle)); } .ds-expiry-opt input { position:absolute; opacity:0; width:1px; height:1px; } .ds-expiry-opt:has(input:checked) { border-color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); background:rgb(var(--c-accent-soft)); color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); font-weight:600; } .ds-expiry-opt:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent)); outline-offset:2px; } @media (max-width:639px) { .ds-expiry-row { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); } }

components.name: Max Views Stepper
components.description: Compact bordered minus / mono number / plus group, 1 to 100.
components.css: .ds-stepper { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:40px; border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); border-radius:9px; background:rgb(var(--c-surface)); transition:border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-stepper:focus-within { border-color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.2); } .ds-stepper button { width:40px; height:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; background:transparent; color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); cursor:pointer; transition:color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-stepper button:first-child { border-radius:9px 0 0 9px; } .ds-stepper button:last-child { border-radius:0 9px 9px 0; } .ds-stepper button:hover:not(:disabled) { color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); background:rgb(var(--c-subtle)); } .ds-stepper button:disabled { opacity:0.4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-stepper input { width:36px; border:0; background:transparent; text-align:center; color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); font-family:"Azeret Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; -moz-appearance:textfield; } .ds-stepper input:focus { outline:none; } .ds-stepper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button, .ds-stepper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button { -webkit-appearance:none; }

components.name: Passphrase Switch
components.description: Pill switch; the passphrase field appears only while it is on.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); cursor:pointer; } .ds-switch { position:relative; width:44px; height:26px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:rgb(var(--c-border)); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background:rgb(var(--c-accent)); } .ds-switch span { position:absolute; top:3px; left:3px; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition:transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] span { transform:translateX(18px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Link With Key
components.description: The shareable URL in a recessed well; the #key fragment is blue on a settling highlight.
components.css: .ds-link { margin:0; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); border-radius:10px; background:rgb(var(--c-subtle)); font-family:"Azeret Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.625; word-break:break-all; user-select:all; } .ds-link-base { color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); } .ds-link-key { color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); font-weight:500; border-radius:3px; padding:0 2px; margin:0 -2px; background:rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.08); animation:ds-key-glow 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 400ms both; } @keyframes ds-key-glow { from { background-color:rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.22); } to { background-color:rgb(var(--c-accent) / 0.08); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link-key { animation:none; } }

components.name: Trust Row
components.description: Three plain facts below the create card (binding user choice): 1 column on phones, 3 from 640px up.
components.html:
• Encrypted in your browserAES-256-GCM via the Web Crypto API.
  • The key stays in the linkIt sits after the #, so it is never sent to the server.
  • Burns after readingGone after the last view or when time runs out.
components.css: .ds-trust { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px; font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; } @media (min-width:640px) { .ds-trust { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:24px; } } .ds-trust li { display:flex; gap:12px; } .ds-trust-chip { margin-top:2px; width:28px; height:28px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:9999px; background:rgb(var(--c-accent-soft)); color:rgb(var(--c-accent)); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; } .ds-trust div { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-trust strong { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); } .ds-trust div span { font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; color:rgb(var(--c-muted)); }

components.name: Burn Confirmation
components.description: Inline alertdialog replacing the Burn now row; Cancel is focused first.
components.html: Destroy this secret for good? The link stops working immediately.
components.css: .ds-burn { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:16px; border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-danger) / 0.3); border-radius:14px; background:rgb(var(--c-danger-soft)); font-family:"Schibsted Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-burn p { flex:1; min-width:18ch; margin:0; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:rgb(var(--c-danger)); } .ds-burn button { height:44px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:10px; font:inherit; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-burn-cancel { border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-border)); background:rgb(var(--c-surface)); color:rgb(var(--c-ink)); font-weight:500; } .ds-burn-cancel:hover { background:rgb(var(--c-subtle)); } .ds-burn-yes { border:0; background:rgb(var(--c-danger)); color:rgb(var(--c-bg)); font-weight:600; } .ds-burn-yes:hover { background:rgb(var(--c-danger) / 0.9); } .ds-burn button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent)); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Hemmelig looks like the tool you already trust for this job: a calm, exact utility in the lineage of 1Password, Bitwarden Send, Stripe and Apple settings. Every route is one focused card on a cool-grey ground, with a short sentence-case headline above it and nothing competing beside it. The craft lives in proportion, hairlines, type spacing and state handling, not in decoration.

Density is moderate and even: 44px controls, 20 to 24px card padding, a single column capped at 720px. One confident blue does all the work of "act here": the primary button, focus, the selected option, and the key segment of the link. Green appears only when something succeeded; red only when something is destroyed or failed. The dark theme mirrors the light one on near-black slate rather than reinterpreting it.

The user tried and rejected a themed "security envelope" world. Nothing from it survives: no envelope, seal, stamp, postal label or "Rekommandert" framing anywhere in the visual system or copy.
keyCharacteristics: One card per route, centred, on a cool-grey ground.
Hairline 1px borders plus a soft, low ambient shadow; 14px card corners, 10px control corners.
A single blue accent; green and red are strictly semantic.
Schibsted Grotesk for everything readable; Azeret Mono only for the secret, the link and numbers.
Light and dark themes are token-for-token mirrors.
Motion is one short entrance per route, plus two moments on the link page (the check draws, the key glows).

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent means "act here" or "this is the key". It never tints decoration, illustration or backgrounds beyond the soft wash behind a selected or informational element.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Green only for a completed outcome, red only for destruction or failure. Neither is used for emphasis or branding.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Every color is a `--c-*` token with a light and a dark value; components reference tokens, never raw colors, so both themes stay in lockstep.

rules.name: The Mono Means Material Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono is used only for the secret itself, the link, the passphrase being chosen, and numbers. Never for headings, labels or decoration.

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Headlines are plain sentence-case statements ending in a period ("Already gone.", "Open it once."). Buttons are verb-first with no period ("Copy link", "Unlock secret").

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the route's card casts a shadow. Controls inside it stay flat; depth inside the card is made with hairlines and recessed wells.

dos: **Do** give each route one centred card (720, 640 or 460px wide) on the Cool Grey Ground, with at most a headline above it and, below it, either the create page's three-column trust row or an action row.
**Do** reference colors only through the `--c-*` tokens so light and dark stay mirrored.
**Do** keep Confident Blue for primary actions, focus, selection and the link key; keep green for success and red for destruction.
**Do** set the secret, the link and numbers in Azeret Mono with tabular figures, and everything else in Schibsted Grotesk.
**Do** keep controls at 44px minimum height (40px for in-card option boxes and the stepper) with 10px radii, and cards at 14px.
**Do** make destruction two-step and inline: a quiet danger button, then a red confirmation panel with Cancel focused first.
**Do** write sentence-case headlines ending in a period, verb-first button labels, and state what the code actually does.
**Do** add every new string to both the English and the Norwegian dictionaries and check the Norwegian layout at 375px and 1440px.
**Do** limit motion to the rise entrance and state feedback, on the `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` curve, and honor reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use themed metaphors: no envelopes, seals, stamps, postal labels, "Rekommandert" markings, vault doors or other staged props. Lock, unlock, shield, flame and check icons are functional signals and stay.
**Don't** add marketing chrome: no gradient heroes, feature-card grids, blobs, testimonials or badge rows. The trust row stays three unboxed items, never cards.
**Don't** collapse the trust row back into a one-line trust line; the user chose the three-column row.
**Don't** add a lede, kicker or eyebrow above or below the create headline.
**Don't** put shadows on controls inside a card, or use hard, offset or colored shadows.
**Don't** use blue, green or red decoratively, or add a second accent hue.
**Don't** use mono for headings or labels, or a display face other than Schibsted Grotesk.
**Don't** turn the expiry options back into a dropdown or split Max views and Passphrase onto separate sections.
**Don't** show the passphrase field or its hint while the passphrase switch is off.
